safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not mention mother having similar symptoms or contact with her.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting household contact history (mother with similar symptoms and contact) can reduce recognition of a contagious outbreak and affect counseling on infection control and exposure risk, but it is unlikely to change immediate management of acute gastroenteritis focused on hydration and escalation precautions. The main impact is loss of epidemiologic context and potentially delayed public-health style advice.

This is largely documentation incompleteness with minimal clinical consequence.
